title: Two git-maintenance fixture tests fail on hosts whose git never auto-starts maintenance, making a local go test -short gate red for innocent work
body: TestAnAgentsCommitStartsNoMaintenance (internal/gitbin) and TestTheHarnessStartsNoGitItDoesNotWaitFor (internal/reconcile) fail on this host with their own 'this fixture proves nothing' message, identically at the pristine base e1cf8e8c and with any change on top, and they fail rather than skip. Together with TestRunEpicFailsClosed (tracked by open tick yjs) they make the acceptance command 'go test -short ./...' red before a tick's own work is judged, which is the exact shape the learnings object to ('the integrated gate refused innocent work'). The fixtures should arm-or-skip on a git that does not exhibit the behaviour they are trying to pin.
